description: Draft status effects for the Test Arena (#arena). These are NOT part of the printed rules or the canonical engine: they exist so the owner can see and feel the effects before any card uses them. Every effect is a paper-world prop (laminate, scorch, ink, tape, staples, stamps) rather than fantasy magic. Each has a generic alias (freeze, burn, poison) for talking about it. The numbers are starting points to be tuned in the simulator. Promoting an effect means moving it into content/dojo-game.json plus a ruling.

round.summary: Round effects resolve in the Honor phase, after everyone has acted, in the order listed below. Fighters regain 2 Focus at Honor (up to their maximum).

effects.name: Scorch
effects.summary: Lose 1 HP per stack at Honor (ignores DEF). Stacks to 3, lasts 2 rounds, refreshes when applied again. Scorching melts Laminate.

effects.name: Ink Blot
effects.summary: Lose 1 HP per stack at Honor, then the ink fades by one stack. Stacks to 4, so 3 stacks cost 3 + 2 + 1 = 6 HP. A smudged fighter recovers 1 less HP from healing.

effects.name: Laminated
effects.summary: Sealed in a laminate pouch: cannot Attack or Brace, -2 Speed. The first Hit rips the pouch open for +2 damage and ends it. Otherwise the seal gives way at Honor. After that the fighter cannot be laminated again for 1 round.

effects.name: Stapled
effects.summary: Pinned to one spot: your Attacks must hit the same zone (High, Mid or Low) as your last Attack. Lasts 2 rounds.

effects.name: Red Tape
effects.summary: Everything takes longer: each card you play costs 1 more Focus per stack. Stacks to 2, lasts 2 rounds.

effects.name: Denied
effects.summary: The next card you play is stamped DENIED and does nothing (it still costs Focus). The stamp is used up when it lands.

effects.name: Paper Cut
effects.summary: Stings whenever you swing: each time you Attack, lose 1 HP per cut. Up to 3 cuts, lasting 3 rounds.

effects.name: Wet Floor
effects.summary: Slippery footing: -2 Speed and -1 DEF for 2 rounds.

keywords.name: Reimburse
keywords.summary: When an Attack with this Hits for at least 2 HP, file a receipt and recover 1 HP (once per round, all sources combined). Never above Max HP. Armor-absorbed and prevented damage does not count.

brace.summary: Play a Defense: +3 DEF against the next Hit this round.
